benchmark: historical author B=0.1. Not B_cri. The Binder source gate stands. The Hamiltonian is the published full spin glass and is not changed.
question: Does frozen interleaved shared-gamma KM clear equal-depth QAOA at N=6, 9, and 12 on fresh k=202..225 when neither pre-registered half of that sample can be reported as the result?
why_this_round: Ferromagnetic-sum and maximin packings lowered KM energy and did not clear N=12. On k=190..201 interleaved KM cleared N=12 and maximin did not. On k=178..189 interleaved KM did not clear N=12. The pass bit moves with the window. This round confirms or fails the frozen circuit under a window control. It is not a new packing and not a new initialization.
not_this_round: No new packing, no new start list, no shell shift, no penalty, no per-layer gamma, no architecture change, no refit of a previous variant, no pooling with k<=201.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: 0..201 were used in earlier rounds. k=100 and k=101 stay held out. 226 and above stay unused.
forbidden: any family whose parameter count is not 1+3L, 2+3L, 3+3L, or 2L

families.nodata: shared gamma, interleaved packing, 1+3L, seed provider
families.K: shared gamma, interleaved packing, 2+3L, seed provider
families.KM: shared gamma, thetaK, thetaM, three shell angles per layer, interleaved triples. 3+3L. The frozen circuit. The claim.
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-4 standard budget, equal depth

packing_rule: The Nov 3 interleaved triples [a, a+N/3, a+2N/3] for a=0..N/3-1. The same formula at every N and every layer. No search. No |J|, no Fiedler, no ferromagnetic sum, no maximin. M is the original block-mean construction on those triples. K is J@J.
architecture: cavity X frame, start |+> in the logical simulator which is |0>^N then W, repeat UcX = W D W then popcount shellSNAP, final W included in the logical trailing transform. One gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM for all layers. Exactly three shell angles per layer, shared by the cavities.
box: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]

seeds.note: Same integer prefixes as round 4. family_index in the perturbation seed is the round-4 index, not the position in this shorter family list. k=202..225 were not fit before.

continuation: KM: Zhou interpolation of the shells with the shared coefficients kept, time-rescaled coefficients times (L-1)/L, perturbations N(0,0.1) and N(0,0.3), two ramps, nested seed from K. QAOA: Zhou interpolation, append-zero, perturbations, two ramps, and the best append-zero plus N(0,0.05). No extra starts.
selection: lowest energy within a repeat; the reported state is the lower of the two repeats. No ground state, eigenvector, E0, or fidelity in packing, features, starts, beam, or selection.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection on the energy-selected state

confirmation.equal_search: each family uses the round-4 start list restricted to nodata, K, KM, and qaoa. KM does not receive extra starts.
confirmation.sample: the pool is block_A union block_B. Historical windows are not resampled.
confirmation.pass_pool_at_N: on all 24 complete instances, wins > losses, and the bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median fidelity difference has lower endpoint > 0
confirmation.window_stable_at_N: each block has all 12 instances complete, each block median dF is > 0, and each block has wins >= losses. The median of an even count is the average of the two central values. A block interval that clears 0 is descriptive and is not a pass.
confirmation.clears_at_N: the pool passes and the size is window-stable
confirmation.overall_partial: N=6 clears and at least one of N=9 or N=12 does not
confirmation.overall_incomplete: any N has fewer than 24 complete pool instances or fewer than 12 complete instances in either block
confirmation.no_batch_selection: The reported verdict is the overall rule. A block, a historical window, or a subset chosen after seeing fidelities is not a result.

secondary_equal_param.role: reported on the pool only, not part of the verdict

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6, repeats inner, so a wall drops the highest k at every N and cuts block B before block A. A cut that leaves either block short is incomplete, not a block-A result.
